plan_needed: A ChatGPT account and any Canva account, including Free and Education. On ChatGPT Business or Enterprise, a workspace admin must turn on Apps & Connectors first. On a Canva team, the Canva admin may need to allow the AI Connector. OpenAI's own plan and country rules couldn't be confirmed (help.openai.com returned HTTP 403).

steps.do: Open ChatGPT and select Settings
steps.see: ChatGPT settings open

steps.do: Select @ Plugins
steps.see: The plugins list

steps.do: Select Canva and follow the prompts to connect your Canva account. Sign in to the right Canva account and authorise Canva if asked
steps.see: Canva's sign-in and permission screens, then you're back in ChatGPT

steps.do: Check the Canva entry
steps.see: Canva shows as connected/enabled

steps.do: Turn Canva on in the chat. Describe what you want, including the type of design and any text, and say you want it in Canva
steps.see: ChatGPT shows design options as previews

steps.do: Select an option, then Save or Open in Canva
steps.see: The design opens in Canva and is saved to your account. Only designs you select are saved

plan_needed: Any Claude plan (directory connectors are available to all users on Claude, Cowork, Claude Desktop and the mobile apps; mobile install is in beta). Any Canva account, including Free. On Claude Team or Enterprise an Owner must add the connector for the organisation first.

steps.do: Go to Customize > Connectors and click + next to Connectors (Canva's own help page calls this Settings > Connectors)
steps.see: The connectors directory

steps.do: Find Canva and click it
steps.see: The Canva connector page: Made by Canva, Anthropic verified

steps.do: Click Connect, then sign in to Canva and approve access
steps.see: Canva's sign-in and authorisation prompts, then Canva shows as connected

steps.do: Click + (or type /), hover over Connectors and turn Canva on
steps.see: Canva's tools are available in that conversation

plan_needed: Claude Team or Enterprise, with the Owner or Primary Owner role. Each member still signs in to Canva themselves.

steps.do: Go to Organization settings > Connectors
steps.see: The organisation's connectors

steps.do: Click Browse connectors, find Canva and click Add to your team
steps.see: Canva becomes available for members to connect

steps.do: Optionally set each tool to Always allow, Needs approval or Blocked
steps.see: The settings apply to everyone, and members can't override them

plan_needed: Canva Enterprise with SSO set up, Okta as the identity provider (beta), Claude Team or Enterprise (beta), and admin access to Canva, Okta and Claude.

steps.do: Open Settings > Security > Cross app access and turn on Enable Cross app access
steps.see: Cross app access is switched on

steps.do: Only if your ID-JAG issuer URL differs from your SAML Identity Provider Issuer: select Add ID-JAG Issuer, enter the ID-JAG Issuer URL and select Add Issuer
steps.see: The issuer appears in the ID-JAG Issuer list

steps.where: Okta admin console and Claude admin settings
steps.do: Set up Okta using Okta's guide, and in Claude follow Anthropic's 'Authorize MCP connectors for your entire organization'
steps.see: The Canva connector is set up for the organisation

steps.do: Check the toggle is on, the issuer is listed, and the Canva connector shows as active in Claude
steps.see: Members who sign in with SSO can use Canva in Claude without setting it up themselves

plan_needed: A personal Google Account (work and school accounts aren't supported), Keep Activity turned on, the Gemini web or mobile app in English, and a Canva account. Resizing, Brand Template search and autofill need a Canva Enterprise team.

steps.where: gemini.google.com or the Gemini mobile app
steps.do: Open Gemini
steps.see: A new chat

steps.do: Ask Gemini to do something in Canva, mentioning 'Canva' or adding @Canva to the prompt
steps.see: If Canva isn't connected, Gemini offers to connect it

steps.do: Choose to connect, and link your Canva account to your Google Account if asked
steps.see: Canva's sign-in and linking screens

steps.do: Follow the remaining on-screen instructions
steps.see: Canva is connected and Gemini carries out the request

plan_needed: Same as connecting from a chat: personal Google Account, Keep Activity on, English, and a Canva account.

steps.do: Click Customize. If you can't see it, click More first
steps.see: Gemini's customisation options

steps.do: At the top, click Connectors
steps.see: The list of connected apps

steps.do: Find Canva and click Add, then follow the on-screen instructions (Canva's page gives the path as Settings > Personal Intelligence > Connected Apps > Other > Canva toggle)
steps.see: Canva's sign-in and linking screens, then Canva is connected

plan_needed: A Microsoft 365 work or school account with Copilot. The Microsoft 365 admin may need to enable the Agent store or approve the agent (you'd see Request approval instead of Add). The Canva team admin may need to allow third-party integrations and the AI Connector. Microsoft's licence rules for this agent weren't confirmed.

steps.do: Select Agent store
steps.see: The agents marketplace

steps.do: Search for Canva agent, select it and install it
steps.see: The Canva agent is installed (or a Request approval option if your organisation needs IT approval)

steps.do: Select New chat, select the plus icon, then Chat with an agent
steps.see: A search for installed agents

steps.do: Type Canva and select the agent
steps.see: A chat with the Canva agent and its suggested prompts

steps.do: Use a suggested prompt or type your own request
steps.see: You may be asked to sign in to Canva and authorise it, then the agent responds

plan_needed: A Microsoft 365 Copilot licence, with Cowork and usage-based billing switched on by the organisation. The Canva team admin may need to allow third-party integrations and the AI Connector.

steps.do: Select the plus icon and open customisation (manage plugins)
steps.see: The plugins list

steps.do: Search for Canva agent and install it
steps.see: Canva agent appears in your plugins

steps.do: Select Canva agent and turn it on with the toggle
steps.see: The Canva agent is enabled for Cowork

steps.do: Type / and choose one of the Canva agent's skills
steps.see: Cowork runs the Canva agent skill

to: AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and others)
plan_needed: An admin on Canva Teams, Business, Nonprofit, Education or Enterprise. The switch applies to the whole team.

steps.do: Go to Admin Dashboard
steps.see: Canva's admin area

steps.do: Select Controls and Permissions, then Third-party integrations
steps.see: The third-party integrations settings, including Canva's AI Connector

steps.do: Turn Canva's AI Connector on or off
steps.see: When it's off, nobody on the team can connect an assistant and existing connections stop working

to: Slack, Gmail, Zoom, Notion, Asana, Google Drive, HubSpot, Gong and other apps
plan_needed: Canva Pro, Teams, Business or Nonprofit (Canva AI 2.0 connectors; marked 'Soon' for Enterprise). Some apps may need organisation or admin approval. Blocked by default in Canva Education.

steps.do: Go to Canva AI, select the plus icon and choose Connect apps
steps.see: The list of apps that work with Canva AI

steps.do: Pick an app. If your account isn't linked yet, select Connect and follow the prompts
steps.see: The app's sign-in and permission screens, then the app is linked

steps.do: Turn the app on with its toggle, type a prompt that names the app or the information you need, and select Submit
steps.see: Canva AI reads from the app (read-only, text only) and uses it as context
